description_en: Modifies the configuration of an ActionTrail audit trail
description_zh: 调整操作审计跟踪的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail update-trail --name trail-test --oss-bucket-name audit-log --oss-key-prefix at-product-account-audit-B --role-name aliyunserviceroleforactiontrail --sls-project-arn acs:log:cn-hangzhou:1594986938260000:project/trail-test --sls-write-role-arn acs:ram::1594986938260000:role/aliyunserviceroleforactiontrail --event-rw All --trail-region All --mns-topic-arn acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:1111:/topics/your-topic-name --api-version 2017-12-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTrail

parameters.help_en:
The name of the trail to update. 

The name must be 6 to 36 characters in length, must start with a lowercase letter, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

Trail names must be unique within the same account
parameters.help_zh:
要更新的跟踪名称。 

长度为6～36个字符，必须以小写英文字母开头，可包含小写英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。

同一个账号内跟踪名称不可重复
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OSS bucket to which the trail delivers events. 

The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length, must start with a lowercase letter or digit, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). 

When you update the trail, make sure that the specified bucket already exists
parameters.help_zh:
跟踪投递的OSS存储空间。 

长度为3～63个字符，必须以小写英文字母或者数字开头，可包含小写英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。 

更新时必须确保该存储空间已经存在
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the log file name in the OSS bucket to which the trail delivers events. 

The prefix must be 6 to 32 characters in length, must start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
跟踪投递的OSS存储空间文件名的前缀。 

长度为6～32个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可包含英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: oss_key_prefix

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role that the user authorizes ActionTrail to assume. Default value: `aliyunserviceroleforactiontrail`
parameters.help_zh: 用户允许操作审计服务扮演的RAM角色名称，默认值：`aliyunserviceroleforactiontrail`
parameters.name: role_name

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Simple Log Service project to which the trail delivers events
parameters.help_zh: 跟踪投递的日志服务项目的ARN
parameters.name: sls_project_arn

parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the RAM role assumed by ActionTrail to deliver management events to the Simple Log Service project.

If you do not specify this parameter, ActionTrail creates a service-linked role to create the corresponding resources. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169244.html.

If you specify this parameter and want to deliver events to the current account, grant the service-linked role permissions of ActionTrail to the RAM role. If you want to deliver events to another account, attach the system access policy for event delivery to the RAM role. For more information about cross-account event delivery, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207462.html
parameters.help_zh:
操作审计向日志服务项目投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN。

如果不指定该参数，操作审计会通过创建服务关联角色来创建相应的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169244.html。

如果指定了该参数，当您需要将事件投递到本账号时，需要为RAM角色授予操作审计服务关联角色权限。当您需要将事件投递到其他账号时，需要为RAM角色绑定操作事件投递的系统权限策略。关于如何进行跨账号投递，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207462.html
parameters.name: sls_write_role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The read/write type of the events to deliver. Valid values:

Write (default): write events.

Read: read events.

All: read events and write events
parameters.help_zh:
投递事件的读写类型，取值：

Write（默认值）：写类型。

Read：读类型。

All：读类型和写类型
parameters.name: event_rw

parameters.help_en:
The region of the trail. 

Default value: All, which indicates that the trail captures events from all regions. 

You can also specify a specific region. To query available regions, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95532.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
跟踪的地域。 

默认值为All，表示跟踪全部地域的事件。 

您也可以指定具体的地域。关于地域的更多信息，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95532.html接口查询
parameters.name: trail_region

parameters.help_en: The ARN of the MNS topic that receives ActionTrail events. Format: `acs:mns:<Region>:<Account ID>:/topics/<topicName>`. If you specify this parameter, a message is sent to the specified MNS topic when events are delivered to OSS
parameters.help_zh: 用于接收操作审计事件的MNS Topic的ARN，格式为：`acs:mns:<Region>:<Account ID>:/topics/<topicName>`。填写此参数后，向OSS中投递事件时，会产生一条消息投递到该MNS Topic。
parameters.name: mns_topic_arn

EventRW.description_en: The read/write type of the delivered events

HomeRegion.description_en: The home region of the trail

MnsTopicArn.description_en: The ARN of the MNS topic that receives ActionTrail events
MnsTopicArn.description_zh: 用于接收操作审计事件的MNS Topic的ARN。

OssBucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket

OssKeyPrefix.description_en: The prefix of the log file name in the OSS bucket
OssKeyPrefix.description_zh: OSS存储空间文件名的前缀

RoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role that the user authorizes ActionTrail to assume
RoleName.description_zh: 用户允许操作审计服务扮演的RAM角色名称

SlsProjectArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Simple Log Service project to which the trail delivers events
SlsProjectArn.description_zh: 跟踪投递的日志服务项目的ARN

SlsWriteRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by ActionTrail to deliver management events to the Simple Log Service project
SlsWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向日志服务项目投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN
